changeSet.author: fcurran
changeSet.comment: Populate joiner table for existing services to inventory locations. Finds all complete services. Finds the location with the most recently completed service. Assigns that location as the inventory location.
changeSet.sql: insert into inventory_location_service (inventory_location_id, service_id) select il.inventory_location_id, s.service_id from service s inner join (select smi.service_id, max(mi.milestone_date) as milestone_date from service_milestone_instance smi inner join milestone_instance mi on smi.milestone_instance_id = mi.milestone_instance_id inner join milestone m on mi.milestone_id = m.milestone_id where m.milestone_code in ('DATA_PROVISIONING_COMPLETE', 'COMPLETE') group by smi.service_id) complete on s.service_id = complete.service_id inner join (select l.client_location_id, location_id, (select l2.location_id from location l2 inner join service s on l2.location_id = s.location_id inner join (select smi.service_id, max(mi.milestone_date) as milestone_date from service_milestone_instance smi inner join milestone_instance mi on smi.milestone_instance_id = mi.milestone_instance_id inner join milestone m on mi.milestone_id = m.milestone_id where m.milestone_code in ('DATA_PROVISIONING_COMPLETE', 'COMPLETE') group by smi.service_id) complete on s.service_id = complete.service_id where l2.client_location_id = l.client_location_id order by complete.milestone_date desc limit 1) as inventory_location_id from location l) il on s.location_id = il.location_id;

changeSet.comment: Trues up active flag on locations where no active services are joined
changeSet.sql: UPDATE location l SET active = 0 WHERE l.active = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inventory_location_service ils JOIN service s ON ils.service_id = s.service_id WHERE ils.inventory_location_id = l.location_id AND s.active = 1 );
